Package repository

Interface FriendshipRepository

All Superinterfaces:
Repository<Tuple<Long,Long>,Friendship>
All Known Implementing Classes:
FriendshipDbRepository, FriendshipFileRepository, InMemoryFriendshipRepository
public interface FriendshipRepository extends Repository<Tuple<Long,Long>,Friendship>
Repository for friendships, adding queries for all friendships of a user. Friendship ids are pairs of user ids, normalized as (smaller id, larger id). The queries have default implementations based on Repository.findAll() and Repository.delete(Object), so every implementation (memory, file) gets them without duplicating code; a database implementation can override them with SQL queries.
